title: An LP-Based Approach for Bilinear Saddle Point Problem with Instance-dependent Guarantee and Noisy Feedback
summary: In this work, we study the sample complexity of obtaining a Nash equilibrium (NE) estimate in two-player zero-sum matrix games with noisy feedback. Specifically, we propose a novel algorithm that repeatedly solves linear programs (LPs) to obtain an NE estimate with bias at most $\varepsilon$ with a sample complexity of $O\left(\frac{m_1 m_2}{\varepsilon\min\{δ^2,σ_0^2,σ^3\}} \log\frac{m_1 m_2}{\varepsilon}\right)$ for general $m_1 \times m_2$ game matrices, where $σ$, $σ_0$, $δ$ are some problem-dependent constants.
